A subscription model charges users a recurring fee—monthly, annually, or even weekly—to access a product or service. ### 🔹 Pros of Subscription Models​. ## What is a One-Time Purchase Model?​. In a one-time purchase model, users pay a single upfront cost to access a product or service permanently.
